name: Rod of the Admiral
body:
Price 19,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This golden rod appears to be an ordinary, though sturdy, spyglass. While in the possession of a creature they gain the effects of a constant water breathing spell and gain a swim speed of 40 feet. In addition once per week they may summon a longboat, crewed by ghostly force. This longboat functions at the rod owner’s commands and rolls Profession (sailor) checks with a +15 bonus. The longboat persists for one week and the owner of the rod may choose to maintain the ship when the duration expires by activating the rod as a purely mental action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,500 gp; Feats Craft Rod; Spells major creation, water breathing
